goal: A README for a slug tool whose numbers are true.

phase.name: docs
phase.objective: Write the README and check it against the code.

criteria.text: The README shows real slugify() output for 'Hello, World!'.

decisions.question: Which slug alphabet?
decisions.choice: ASCII lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens

nodes.objective: Write README.md: purpose and real slugify() output for 'Hello, World!'.
nodes.check: python3.11 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');import slug;sys.exit(0 if slug.slugify('Hello, World!')=='hello-world' else 1)"
nodes.verifier: docs-reviewer: runs each README example and compares the output with the text

nodes.objective: Run the whole tool end to end and fix seams.

gates.check: python3.11 -c "import sys;sys.exit(0 if 'hello-world' in open('README.md').read() else 1)"
